name: Metadologie : Payments and Subscriptions
author: metadologie

sections.description:
Metadologie : Payments and Subscriptions integrates the Metadologie payment platform seamlessly into your WooCommerce/WordPress store. It empowers merchants to offer flexible, conversational-style payment options that improve conversion rates and simplify the billing process.

Key Features
* Email Payment Links: Automatically generate and send secure payment links to customers, allowing them to pay via their preferred method without logging into a store account.
* ACH Bank Transfers: Dedicated support for ACH payments via a secure, embedded portal.
* HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
* Block Support: Integrated with the modern WooCommerce Cart and Checkout Blocks.

Security & Compliance
This plugin relies on the Metadologie platform to securely tokenize payment data. No sensitive cardholder data (PAN/CVV) is stored on your WordPress server. All API communications are authenticated using HMAC-SHA256 signatures.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Metadologie payment platform to process payments. This connection is required for the plugin to function.

Service Used: Metadologie Payment API
Service Provider: Metadologie (https://metadologie.com)

When Data is Sent:

  • When a store administrator connects their store to the Metadologie platform
  • When a customer initiates a payment (credit card, ACH, or payment link)
  • When a refund is processed

Data Transmitted:

  • Store URL and WooCommerce API credentials (for store connection only)
  • Order details: order ID, amount, currency
  • Customer billing information: name, email, phone, billing address
  • Payment method tokens (no raw card numbers are transmitted or stored)

Important: No sensitive cardholder data (PAN/CVV) is ever stored on your WordPress server. All payment data is securely tokenized by the Metadologie platform. This plugin does not track users without their explicit consent during the payment process.

AuthVia CDN (Payment Form Components)

This plugin also uses the AuthVia CDN to load the secure credit card input component during checkout.

Service Used: AuthVia Payment Form Components
Service Provider: AuthVia (https://authvia.com)
CDN URL: https://cdn.authvia.com

When Loaded:

  • When a customer selects credit card payment during checkout
  • When processing subscription payments in the admin panel

What is Loaded:

  • A secure web component for credit card input (av-payment-method-credit-card)
  • This component handles card tokenization directly with the payment processor
  • No card data passes through or is stored on your WordPress server

Privacy & Terms:

  • AuthVia Privacy Policy
  • AuthVia Terms of Service

Metadologie Privacy & Terms

  • Metadologie Privacy Policy
  • Metadologie Terms of Service

Configuration

Step 1: Connect Store
1. Navigate to Metadologie in the WordPress sidebar.
2. Buy a subscription according to your need.
3. You will be prompted to connect your store once the subscription is active.
4. Click Connect Store.

Step 2: Merchant Details
1. Once connected, the merchant will be created for the user automatically, showing the details.
2. Toggle the merchant to “Active” to enable it for checkout.
sections.installation:
1. Search: Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard and search for “Metadologie”.
  2. Install: Click Install Now on the Metadologie : Payments and Subscriptions plugin.
  3. Activate: Click Activate to enable the plugin.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Metadologie account?

Yes, you must have an active merchant account with Metadologie to process payments. Your account will be managed through the Metadologie platform.

Does this store credit card numbers?

No. All payment data is tokenized securely via the Metadologie platform. Your server never touches raw credit card data.

Is this compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, version 1.2.0+ is fully compatible with HPOS.

Where can I get support?

Please contact Metadologie support at support@metadologie.com or visit our website for documentation.
sections.changelog:
1.2.2 – 2026-02-06

  • Security: Enhanced data sanitization, output escaping, and code compliance to meet strict security standards.
  • Security: Refined merchant validation workflow to ensure secure, unique onboarding per installation.
  • Enhancement: Improved connection error handling with automatic redirection for a smoother setup experience.
  • Fix: Polished UI layout to resolve overlap issues in error notification displays.
  • Enhancement: Updated Enterprise plan card design in the subscription management screen.
  • Enhancement: Improved error messaging specificity in subscription credit card forms for better user feedback.

1.2.1 – 2026-01-19

  • Enhancement: Clarified gateway method titles to “Metadologie Payments” for better customer recognition.
  • Enhancement: Updated checkout UI to require explicit payment method selection, preventing accidental default charges.
  • Compatibility: Restored full credit card support for Classic WooCommerce shortcode checkout.
  • Compatibility: Enhanced WooCommerce Blocks integration with improved UI state management.
  • Enhancement: Streamlined checkout flow by optimizing payment method options.
  • Stability: Resolved potential session validation conflicts in Classic checkout scripts.
  • Security: Strengthened REST API access controls and nonce validation.

1.2.0 – 2025-12-15

  • Feature: Added configurable service charges for flexible fee management.
  • Enhancement: Modernized admin interface with improved merchant toggle controls.
  • Compatibility: Full support for WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).
  • Enhancement: Optimized integration with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

1.1.0 – 2025-10-01

  • Feature: Introduced secure ACH Bank Transfer payment method.
  • Enhancement: Enhanced multi-merchant profile management capabilities.
  • Maintenance: Various bug fixes and performance optimizations.

1.0.0 – 2025-08-01

  • Initial release.
